question: Does building Specctra wire_keepout as a trace-only keepout (router.wire_keepout=traces_only) leave fewer unrouted connections than Java's reading (a full keepout) on at least N-1 of the eligible boards, with none worse, no new DRC errors, no via in a pad and no copper below its class width? The second candidate, the pour guard's traces mode (plane_traces), is judged the same way against the same baseline with candidate_arm set to plane_traces (a second gate run on this file's arms; the registration's hash covers both).

keepout.engine: freerouting-rs at the commit that lands P04's default-tree decision, with Q09 (router.wire_keepout unset)

plane_obstacle_net_classes.Issue754-avionics_hub: none (no signal-layer pour): not eligible for this arm

settings.classes_rule: the net classes of the islands the wire_keepouts cover, decided from the input (canary-pwr: +12V_BUS and +5V_PI, class Power_High)

boards.eligibility: traces_only: a board with at least one structure-level wire_keepout (Issue754, canary-pwr in2-open-wirekeepout); plane_traces: a board with a signal-layer pour of a listed class (both canary-pwr in2-open variants). Decided from the inputs. Every benchmark-set board is ineligible for both (no wire_keepout, no listed pour) and is run only as the identity check: each arm's session must be byte-identical to the keepout arm's there.
boards.canary_grouping: the two canary-pwr rows are one board (gate collect --group canary-pwr=canary-pwr)

grading: canary-pwr by canary-23's ses_import.py, kicad-cli pcb drc --schematic-parity --refill-zones --severity-all, via_in_pad.py and inner_tracks.py run with In2 (Power.Cu) allowed for signals (the in2-open variants route on it by design); Issue754 has no .kicad_pcb and is graded by freerouting-dev ses-diff statistics only (not a KiCad grade, so it can't be the deciding row)

metric_definitions.unrouted: KiCad unconnected_items after ses_import and refill (canary-pwr); freerouting-dev ses-diff incomplete connections (Issue754)
metric_definitions.foreign_island_mm: summed length of the trace segments of every net inside a conduction area of another net of a listed class on the same layer (canary-pwr: the +12V_BUS and +5V_PI planes on Power.Cu); 166 mm on in2-open with Java 46bf9e2ef is the number to beat

decision_table.pass: make the candidate's value the default; DIVERGENCES line with the numbers
decision_table.fail: the setting stays opt-in (the KiCad plugin can pass it for boards that need it); the numbers go in Q09.5's done note
decision_table.note: with two eligible boards (Issue754 and the canary-pwr group) the pass rule's three-board minimum can't be met, so the defaults can't change on this set; a third eligible board (a real board with a tracks-only rule area, read directly from .kicad_pcb by K06 or exported) goes in an amendment before its first number

timing: measured only after P04's default-tree decision (Q00 README, 'Order and critical path'); a pre-P04 dry run on canary-pwr is recorded in Q09.5's note as a dry run, not judged
